description:
Embark on a captivating 2-hour Boston Harbor sunset sail aboard our sister ships, Schooners Adirondack III and II, elegantly styled 80-foot pilot schooners. As the sun descends below the horizon, witness the city's waterfront landmarks bathed in the golden hues of twilight. Renowned as the fastest and most elegant schooners in Boston Harbor, the Adirondacks promise a smooth and gentle sailing experience complemented by exceptional customer service from our captain and crew.

Relax and unwind with your loved ones aboard our stellar vessels, enjoying the comfort and tranquility of the water. Within moments of departing the dock, leave behind the distractions of land as you immerse yourself in the serene ambiance of a sunset sailing cruise. Let the beauty of the harbor and the warmth of the setting sun create unforgettable memories on this unforgettable journey.
##Notable Sites:
- One of the first sites you’ll see on our day sail is the Boston Seaport District. There's much to be seen here as the area features many newly constructed buildings, as well as the classic structures that originally comprised Boston’s waterfront community. 
- We will point out The Moakley Federal Courthouse at Fan Pier, the World Trade Center, as well as Harpoon Brewery
- As our trip extends, we will sail through the Inner Harbor Islands, getting as close as we can to some of our historical islands including: Castle Island featuring Fort Independence and the Donald McKay Monument, Spectacle Island, and Long Island with the Long Island Head Light House.

Your knowledgeable captain and crew are always ready to answer questions about the sights and history of Boston Harbor and its surrounding areas. From interesting facts to old-time legends, the maritime world of Boston has many great stories to offer. Ask them anything you'd like to know!

##About the Adirondack Schooners
Our schooners, the Adirondack III and Adirondack II, pay homage to the pilot schooners of the 1890s. They feature teak decks, mahogany trimmings, and two bathrooms, offering comfort and convenience. Crafted by Scarano Boat Building of Albany, NY, they are designed for spectacular sightseeing adventures with ample deck space and seating for up to 41 or 52 passengers.

Sailing on these vessels is a delight, as they move through the water efficiently and beautifully. Operated by Coast Guard-certified captains and a friendly, talented crew, our vessels are known for their hospitality and safety. Feel free to ask our crew about the boat or any of the Boston sites as you enjoy your journey through the historic harbor.
